name: gamenet_reassign_player_colors_and_refresh_rows
description: GameNet::ReassignPlayerColorsAndRefreshRows recomputes every player row color from zNetwork records, refreshes HUD row state, and reapplies modal tint.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet player-row/HUD source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x432e70 validates iteration from g_GameNetPlayerRowHead, zNetwork::GetPlayerColorIndexByKey(row->playerKey), storing playerColorIndex and 00RRGGBB row color, copying the packed color into embedded HUD panel tint fields, setting the HUD panel active flag, calling HudUi::RefreshScoreboardEntryRow, calling GameNetPlayerRow::ApplyPlayerColorTint, advancing by row->next, and returning 1.
